title: High-Stakes U.S.-China Summit Concludes: Key Discussions and Agreements
description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping conclude a crucial two-day state visit focused on U.S.-China relations. The discussions addressed trade, Taiwan, and regional stability. While positive trade developments emerged, Xi issued a warning on Taiwan, emphasizing the island's strategic significance. The summit also highlighted potential new trade agreements, including China's interest in purchasing Boeing jets.

title: China fires verbal warning shot at US over Taiwan
description: Any misstep over Taiwan could push the U.S. and China toward direct confrontation, Chinese leader Xi Jinping told President Donald Trump.

title: China offers Trump grand welcome, but issues warning on Taiwan
description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping hosted President Trump and offered the U.S. a "new vision" of relations more focused on trade and collaboration than on confrontation. Trump in turn, offered a future in which he and Xi were "united and together." But China's president also had a stark warning to his American counterpart about Taiwan. Nick Schifrin reports from Beijing.

title: Taiwan thanks US for support after China warning
description: TAIPEI, May 14 : Taiwan said it is grateful for the long-term support of the United States after Xi warned Trump on Thursday about potential “clashes and even conflicts” over the self-ruled island China claims as its own. “The government views all actions that contribute to regional stability and the management of potential risks from authoritarian expansion positively and continues to work with the United States in various aspects of our relationship,” said Michelle Lee, a spokesperson for Taiwan’s premier.
